# Welcome to Cave Horror Project 1

If you need any help or have any suggestions for future updates, please join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/QwH2ZQa)!
#
Step back into the darkness of Cave Horror Project, the ultimate horror survival modpack where every step into the shadows could be your last. Since version 2.0 and 3.0, the experience has been completely transformed with new quests, bosses, decorations, and terrifying encounters.

## 📖 Full Questline
- Over 200 quests across multiple chapters, now with a proper progression path alongside some optional quests.

![Quests](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4df371033435f5c1f53d064a3733f0438a67f313_0.webp)

## 🪓 Horror-Themed Additions & Custom Mods
- Creepy Decorations Mod – Add unsettling props like Haunted Pumpkins, Broken Dolls, and more to intensify the atmosphere.
- Many horror mods such as The Anomaly, Cave Dweller or Doctor Who: Weeping Angels.
- Enhanced Herobrine events with legacy structures.

![Creepy Decorations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d6e65f83a521d6cbb3e0d95ddc5e37bb12e7a12_0.webp)

## 🎮 Immersive Experience & Menus
- Completely redesigned main menus for singleplayer and multiplayer.
- Added special resource packs (Enhanced Audio, Creepy Speaker, Cave Packer, and more) for deeper immersion.
- Shader and lighting improvements for eerie, cinematic visuals.

Main menu

## 🗣 Multiplayer Horror Experience
- Simple Voice Chat combined with Simple Void Radio Mod – craft walkie-talkies and communicate in-game even at a distance.
- Multiplayer-friendly quest and event system.

Walkie-talkie

## ⚔ New Encounters & Boss Fights
- Apollion and Red’s Anomaly spawn rates adjusted for balanced horror encounters.
- Herobrine’s abilities improved, but villagers are now safe from possession.
- Many difficult bosses from the ArPhEx Mod.

TORMENTOR

## 🔧 Quality of Life & Performance
- Backpack crafting rebalanced (Backpacked and Sophisticated Backpacks mods).
- Updated mods and Forge versions for stability.
- Streamlined quest crafting recipes for horror-themed items.

New backpack crafting recipe

This is the Cave Horror Project, combining chilling atmosphere, deep story, and heart-pounding survival gameplay. Whether solo or with friends, the horrors that await will test your courage to the limit.

## ✨ Discover more of our projects on our website!
[website image](https://withrage.com/)

versions.name: Cave Horror Project 1 v3.6
versions.changelog:
## Added:
- Added BandwidthOptimizer mod
- Added Map Distance Fix mod
## Changed:
- Disabled item stealing for Seagulls
- Changed the drop chance for Lifestealer Skull to 50%
- Updated the default options
- Updated mods
- Updated resource packs
- Updated shader packs
- Updated to Forge 47.4.23
## Other (from our Core mod):
- Added new drops for Cave Dweller - Torn Hide and Dweller Claw
- Added new drop for The Man From The Fog - Fog Fragment
- Added new Dweller Boots item - crafted from Torn Hide, grants you a new effect called the Dweller's Instinct which makes you move and sneak faster while underground
- Added new Fog Crystal item - crafted from Tear Of The Man and 4 Fog Fragments, doesn't have any uses yet tho
- Added a new advancement for defeating Cave Dweller

versions.name: Cave Horror Project 1 v3.5
versions.changelog:
## Added:
- Added ArPhEx: BOP Integration mod
- Added Midnight Nightmares mod
- Added Waystones mod
- Added Chapter 6 with 42 new quests (unlocked after finishing Chapter 1-5 progression)
- Added new helping tips for quests
## Changed:
- Made the first 5 chapters be unlocked from the start (you will no longer need to complete Chapter 1 progression to start Chapter 2 progression)
- Decreased stalk frequency for The Obsessed
- Disabled item stealing for The Obsessed
- Renamed the enchanted book quest rewards inside reward tables so you can now actually see what the book is
- Updated default options
- Updated mods
- Updated resource packs
- Updated to Forge 47.4.21
## Other:
- From The Fog now has a specific default configuration so you should see Herobrine a bit more often
- ArPhEx mobs now spawn properly in modded biomes thanks to our new mod ArPhEx: BOP Integration - you can find the full spawn biomes in this [document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1TPdLwPSleQukF3gW0_UCEQFCwnzIWYzjNQuab0sz6UI/edit?usp=sharing)

versions.name: Cave Horror Project 1 v3.4
versions.changelog:
## Added:
- Added BiomeSpy mod
- Added EMI mod
- Added FastFurnace mod
- Added FastSuite mod
- Added FastWorkbench mod
- Added Flerovium mod
- Added Macaw's Roofs mod
- Added ModernFix mod
- Added Structure Layout Optimizer mod
- Added 23 new quests
## Removed:
- Removed Structure Essentials mod
## Changed:
- Changed boss quests to not be repeatable
- Changed the quest road layout
- Changed specific quests from ArPhEx and Born in Chaos mods in each chapter to be dependant on each other making a smaller progression path in each chapter
- Changed the reward system to contain choice reward chests instead of random reward chests
- Changed the reward loot tables to not contain duplicate items that were used for random rewards
- Changed several quest objectives
- Changed some quests to be set as optional
- Fixed the Spider Moth boss quest not detecting completion correctly
- Changed the generation weight of Biomes O'Plenty regions
- Changed the spawnrates for ArPhEx mobs
- Changed the spawnrate for The Knocker
- Updated mods
- Updated resource packs
- Updated shader packs
## Other:
- Ancient Debris now drops Netherite Scraps directly to prevent duplication exploints - sorry for that!

versions.name: Cave Horror Project 1 v3.3

## Added:

## Removed:
